gloss: food and drink, eating and drinking

definitions.gloss: food and drink, eating and drinking
definitions.explanation: The act of eating and drinking, or food and beverages together.

examples.japanese: {飲食|いんしょく}{禁止|きんし}。
{飲食|いんしょく}を{楽|たの}しむ。

notes:
{飲食|いんしょく} combines {飲|いん} (drink) + {食|しょく} (eat).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {飲食店|いんしょくてん}: restaurant, eatery
- {飲食|いんしょく}{禁止|きんし}: no food or drink allowed
- {飲食|いんしょく}{業|ぎょう}: food and beverage industry
- {飲食|いんしょく}{物|ぶつ}: food and drink items

Used primarily in formal contexts, signs, and industry terminology. In everyday speech, {食|た}べたり{飲|の}んだり is more common.
